short_description: Canvas Dx is the first FDA-authorized AI-based diagnostic aid for autism spectrum disorder, helping clinicians diagnose ASD in children ages 18 months to 6 years with high accuracy.
description: Cognoa Canvas Dx is an FDA De Novo-authorized machine learning-based diagnostic aid that helps healthcare providers diagnose autism spectrum disorder (ASD) in children ages 18 months to 5 years 11 months. The system combines caregiver questionnaires, video analysis of child behavior, and healthcare provider assessments to generate a diagnostic output. With 95% specificity and 97% negative predictive value, Canvas Dx can reduce the time to diagnosis from years to weeks, addressing a critical bottleneck where children often wait 2-4 years for specialist evaluation.

faqs.a: Canvas Dx is the first FDA-authorized AI-based diagnostic aid for autism spectrum disorder. It helps clinicians diagnose ASD in children ages 18 months to 6 years by combining caregiver questionnaires, video analysis, and provider assessments.
Canvas Dx has 95% specificity (correctly identifying children without ASD) and 97% negative predictive value. It was validated in clinical trials and received FDA De Novo authorization in 2021.
Canvas Dx is a prescription-only diagnostic device that must be ordered by a licensed healthcare provider such as a pediatrician, developmental pediatrician, or child psychiatrist.

faqs.q: How much does Canvas Dx cost?
faqs.a: Canvas Dx typically costs $300-600 per assessment. It may be covered by commercial insurance or Medicaid in some states. Health systems can get volume pricing for broader implementation.

faqs.q: How does Canvas Dx reduce diagnosis time?
faqs.a: Traditional autism diagnosis often takes 2-4 years due to specialist waitlists. Canvas Dx enables primary care providers to make or rule out ASD diagnosis in their office, reducing wait times from years to weeks.
